title: ALYBH-RE Models
description: Reshaped 3D Models with related Vanilla-like textures, a part of ALYBH-REconstruction.
body:
Introduction
-
3D Models pack, a part of [ALYBH-RE](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/alybh-reconstruction).  
Including models and related textures, check Gallery to view contents.  
Made and modified freely with Blockbench.  
The early part of texture may looks clutter, use Blockbench for convenience if you want to edit the textures.
